todo_line: - [ ] 003 Introduce and focused-test an app-owned dashboard query/view-model boundary that begins from the authenticated email and fresh active-club authority; move all projection-backed dashboard data behind one coherent socket assign, subscribe before the connected initial read, preserve route/access error semantics and transient LiveView state, and retain the existing notification predicates provisionally.

validation.evidence: 85 focused query, presentation, dashboard, admission, removal and targeted-add tests passed with 0 failures.
All Elixir source and test files are formatted.

notes: The new MembaWeb.MemberDashboardQuery normalizes the authenticated email and resolves active clubs on every invocation before delegating to the existing presentation boundary. MemberDashboardLive subscribes before its connected reads, retains the routed club ID and identity email as stable inputs, and stores projection-backed display and authorization data only under :dashboard; render-local assign/2 expansion is required so LiveView change tracking emits refreshed dashboard diffs without creating socket mirrors. Tests prove stale active-club snapshots cannot preserve access, selected-group errors remain distinct, the single-assign boundary is maintained, and an open filtered member picker survives a successful dashboard replacement. The initial expected TDD failure was the absent query module; a superseded diagnostic admission-suite failure exposed Map.merge/2 bypassing LiveView change tracking and was fixed with render-local assign/2. Existing provisional projector predicates remain intentionally unchanged for later tasks.
